title: Chapter 1302 - 44: The Terrifying Lin Yuan
content:
Chapter 1302 - 44: The Terrifying Lin Yuan

Chapter 1302: Chapter 44: The Terrifying Lin Yuan

Rumble——

Accompanied by Lin Yuan’s dragging, as if pulling the entire Origin Source World, the vast Demonic Qi permeated the four corners of heaven and earth, boiling simultaneously.

Under the sky, the Demon God, who had been overlooking from above, suddenly staggered. Finally, with a desperate struggle of its giant tail and the collaboration of the surrounding Demonic Qi, it forcibly broke free from Lin Yuan and returned to its rear.

"Hahaha, quite some strength."

Lin Yuan glanced at his right hand, its surface covered with densely packed black pits, all caused by the corrosion when gripping the giant tail.

Was the Demon God’s giant tail so easy to grab? The intense backlash it generated was enough to give a thirteenth-level time-being a headache.

Lin Yuan only dared to do this after completely establishing the Infinite Constant Sand Particle World, dividing the backlash among each particle world.

"Lord Galaxy actually..."

In the hidden world, several Sect Masters were utterly astonished.

If earlier, Lin Yuan had merely been fully defending against the Demon God’s attack.

Then just now, by actively pulling the Demon God’s rear tail, causing its foundation to falter and almost dragging it away, meant Lin Yuan already possessed the front-facing strength to shake the Demon God.

"Isn’t Lord Galaxy an Eternal Lord, how could he possibly shake the Demon God?"

The minds of many senior members of the Eternal Sect went blank.

Barely blocking the Demon God’s attacks and counterattacking to shake it are entirely different matters.

The latter means the strength difference with the Demon God is not very large, and they can even be said to be on the same level.

All around, the powerhouses of the Supreme Saint Sect and Holy Sect were also watching and peeking.

After Lin Yuan revealed his towering true form, even at a great distance, he could still faintly observe and perceive the ongoing resistance against the Demon God’s attacks.

"Did Lord Galaxy shake the Demon God?"

"Isn’t it said that the Demon God is on par with an Eternal Lord?"

The numerous powerhouses were full of disbelief. Although the confrontation between Lin Yuan and the Demon God involved countless mysteries in essence, what was displayed were just punches and kicks.

It wasn’t very difficult to distinguish.

...

The black pits on the surface of his right hand quickly recovered.

Lin Yuan looked at the Demon God, his eyes filled with intense battle intent.

After refining the Eternal Source, the Infinite Constant Sand Particle World in his body was completely established, with every particle world resonating with each other, unleashing power more than tenfold to a hundredfold stronger than before it was fully developed.

Because of this.

Lin Yuan was able to transition from barely resisting the Demon God’s attacks to directly shaking the Demon God.

Because if he now unleashed his full strength, he could indeed pose a threat to the Demon God—not a life-and-death threat, but at least one that would make the opponent take him seriously.

"It would be rude not to reciprocate."

Lin Yuan smiled at the somewhat dazed Demon God.

His figure directly merged into space-time, disappearing from where he stood.

"Hmm?"

Seeing this, the Demon God’s hollow eyes became solemn. This world filled with Demonic Qi, which equated to the Demon God’s domain, where the Demonic Qi enveloped was within the Demon God’s control.

But at the moment Lin Yuan disappeared, the Demon God sensed losing control of the surrounding heaven and earth.

This loss was forced, with no warning.

In the next moment.

Lin Yuan’s massive figure appeared next to the Demon God, raising his hand for a slap.

The Demon God’s body also began to quickly enlarge, becoming as tall as Lin Yuan, and its giant tail swung again.

Colliding with the slap from Lin Yuan.

Diye——

A tremendous amount of space-time and heaven and earth continuously annihilated, and this annihilation was foundational, enough to cause irreversible impacts on the Origin World, but neither Lin Yuan nor the Demon God cared about this at the moment.

Lin Yuan had not yet stepped into the thirteenth level, although his foundation was accumulated to the extreme, facing a Demon God on par with the Eternal Lord, naturally dared not hold back.

Boom!

This confrontation clearly favored the Demon God, with Lin Yuan suddenly disappearing and then reappearing, catching the Demon God off guard, who could only barely defend.

The result was the Demon God retreating several steps backwards.

Before the Demon God could react in any way.

Lin Yuan’s figure disappeared once again.

"Roar!!!"

With no hesitation, the Demon God directly roared!

This roar was like the wrath of heaven and earth, an apocalyptic roar.

The ’black ripples’ formed by the roar swept towards all directions, the ground was torn apart by the roaring sound, space-time collapsed in the roaring sound, and the central vast range of heaven and earth was affected by the roaring sound, continuously annihilating.

As for the hidden world nearby, at the critical moment, another defense Eternal Treasure was activated. Coupled with the fact that the Demon God’s roar was not targeted at the hidden world, they barely managed to withstand it.

As the ’black ripples’ spread, Lin Yuan’s figure was forced to reveal itself, watching the Demon God from afar.

The power of the black ripples was strong, but it still had no effect on Lin Yuan at this moment. With the Infinite Constant Sand Particle World operating, the destructive force formed by the ’black ripples’ was instantly diluted.

No matter how strong an attack, spread into infinite particles, when averaged across each particle world, posed much less threat.

"The Roaring of the Demon God, this is the Roaring of the Demon God, the Demon God’s trump card killer move."

In the hidden world, several Sect Masters watched in shock as the ’black ripples’ spread to all sides.

In the various futures predicted by the Eternal Lords, when the Demon God, with its instinctual consciousness, completely suppressed the Origin World’s consciousness, focusing on attacking the hidden world, this move would be used.

According to the foresight of the Eternal Lords, when the Demon God uses this move, the situation of this Fang Yuan World would be extremely dire.

Because under the Roaring of the Demon God, even the hidden world, sheltered by multiple defensive Eternal Treasures, wouldn’t hold out for long.

"After endless ages, the move the Demon God would use has been forced out early by Lord Galaxy?"

The Sect Master of the Eternal Infinite Sect trembled inside, being close to the battle, he could naturally see the Demon God’s passive state.

If the Roaring of the Demon God was not used, the Demon God would be caught up in Lin Yuan’s endless cycle of disappearing and appearing.

By then, even if the Demon God didn’t fall into a complete disadvantage, it would lose the initiative.

"So powerful."

The numerous elders and high-level personnel of the other sects swallowed hard.

The more they knew, the more they could understand Lin Yuan’s might.

That’s a Demon God!

What kind of strength does Lin Yuan possess, to have a battle with the Demon God that goes back and forth?

In the distance.

The Demon God, who revealed Lin Yuan’s form with its roar, stared blankly at Lin Yuan, then shook the giant tail behind it, striding towards Lin Yuan to attack.

The way the Demon God fights is exceedingly primitive, unlike Lin Yuan, who blends into time and space to disappear, reappearing beside its target.

Yet with each step the Demon God takes, the surrounding time and space gather more, along with the ’black ripple’ formed by the formless and intangible roar of the Demon God, still vibrating.

"Bang!"

Lin Yuan also charged forward in a big stride.

The Martial Arts Evolution Road he follows excels in close combat, and with the Infinite Constant Sand World completely opened, each punch and kick carries infinite power.

He is even more fearless of this fighting style.

In an instant, the two gigantic figures collided.

"Buzz~"

The Demon God’s eyes filled with endless darkness, where it looked, the tangible and intangible both transforming into Demonic Qi.

Inside Lin Yuan, countless particles lit up, the infinite Constant Sand Particle World fully operating, using the universe within his body as the core, the power unleashed continuously clashed and nullified the darkness in the Demon God’s eyes.

Seizing the opportunity, Lin Yuan reached with his left hand towards the Demon God’s giant tail, trying to pull it up, but the Demon God responded with another roar.

The ’black ripple’ kept vibrating at close range, even Lin Yuan had to divert some mental energy to resist.

"That move?" In the hidden world, several Sect Masters saw the endless darkness in the Demon God’s eyes, which was not predicted by any of the Eternal Lords.

Evidently, even at the end, across many future timelines, they did not force the Demon God to use this move.

And the darkness in the Demon God’s eyes seemed to be the most powerful, far surpassing the previous moves, even Lin Yuan was cautiously defending against it.

"Die."

Lin Yuan once again grabbed the Demon God’s giant tail with his left hand, while his right hand locked onto the Demon God’s throat, intending to tear it apart, but then the Demon God wrapped its arms around Lin Yuan, their auras violently clashing, even the omnipresent Demonic Qi was completely obliterated under this intense vibration.

The Demon God’s physical body was incredibly strong, even surpassing Lin Yuan, but Lin Yuan had the support of the infinite particle world and the universe within him, making the battle between the two become a deadlock for a moment.

The roars continued, the black ripple kept sweeping through.

The giant tail swung, striking towards Lin Yuan time and again.

But Lin Yuan didn’t mind at all, with deep reserves and multiple protective divine skills, even when injured, he could recover quickly, completely engaging in an exchange of injuries with the Demon God.

Of course, the Demon God, with its endless Demonic Qi support, also barely sustained any injuries.

But it became apparent that the Demon God couldn’t handle Lin Yuan at all.

...

In the hidden world.

Many powerful beings silently watched the two gigantic figures fighting outside.

"Lord Galaxy can actually fight the Demon God to this extent?"

"Eternal Lord? Could Lord Galaxy indeed be an Eternal Lord?"

Several Sect Masters exchanged glances, initially certain that Lin Yuan was not an Eternal Lord.

Because since the great changes in the world began, there had been no heavenly phenomena indicating the emergence of an Eternal Lord.

But now, they’re not sure about Lin.

Whoosh!

In a space-time of collapse and destruction.

The Demon God, who had been fighting alongside Lin Yuan, suddenly swept its giant tail and rapidly retreated backward.

"Hmm?"

Lin Yuan also halted, looking towards the Demon God that stopped in the distance.

Soon.

Under Lin Yuan’s gaze.

The Demon God’s figure dissolved directly, merging into the vast Demonic Qi surrounding them.

"The Demon God retreated?"

Lin Yuan understood in his heart.

Clearly, the Demon God realized that continuing to fight with Lin Yuan in such a manner would only keep itself dragged on, not to mention destroying the hidden world or even using its own instinct to suppress the Source World consciousness.

At first, it kept attacking the hidden world because it saw the hope of destroying it, thinking it only needed to persist for millions or even tens of millions of years.

But fighting with Lin Yuan?

Following this trend, even after battling for billions or tens of billions of years, it wouldn’t determine a victor.

So it chose to retreat and leave directly.

The Demon God possessed no specific will or complex emotions such as pride.

When the situation offered no advantage, it made decisions most beneficial for itself.

"That’s fine too."

Lin Yuan nodded slightly.

...

In the hidden world, countless beings looked up, the disappearance of the Demon God letting them more directly perceive Lin Yuan’s vastness. His true form standing like a colossus, the terrifying aura flowing on his body after fighting the Demon God, exuded immense oppression.

"Is it over?"

Several Sect Masters showed expressions of excitement.

...

Outside the Source World.

In a twisted space-time.

Over a dozen towering figures stood here, their gazes occasionally glancing towards the distant Source World.

However, at this moment, the space surrounding the Source World was filled with endless Demonic Qi, enveloping the entire Source World like an endless darkness.

Yet at this time.

One of the towering figures suddenly changed expression, looking back towards the distant Source World.

Its expression showing a trace of disbelief:

"What is that?"
